sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 小新台湾 (Crayon Shin-chan TW) CBT 测试首周报告
模块编号 : 03 - 在线时长分布与留存关卡阶段对比 (TW CBT vs SG CBT/OBT)
数据表   : 
  - 小新繁体 CBT: ta.v_event_18 (AppID 18)
  - 小新新加坡  : ta.v_event_13 (AppID 13)
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),
UserBlacklist13 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
UserBlacklist18 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),

-- 1. 小新繁体 CBT 用户时长 (分钟)
TW_UserDuration AS (
    SELECT
        '1.小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e."#duration" AS DOUBLE), 0.0)) / 60.0 AS duration_minutes
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist18 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND e."$part_event" = 'ta_app_end'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

-- 2. 小新新加坡 CBT 用户时长 (分钟)
SG_UserDuration AS (
    SELECT
        '2.小新新加坡OBT1' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e."#duration" AS DOUBLE), 0.0)) / 60.0 AS duration_minutes
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist13 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'ta_app_end'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

CombinedDuration AS (
    SELECT * FROM TW_UserDuration
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SG_UserDuration
),

DurationBuckets AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        CASE
            WHEN duration_minutes < 10 THEN '01. <10分钟'
            WHEN duration_minutes < 30 THEN '02. 10-30分钟'
            WHEN duration_minutes < 60 THEN '03. 30-60分钟'
            WHEN duration_minutes < 120 THEN '04. 1-2小时'
            WHEN duration_minutes < 240 THEN '05. 2-4小时'
            ELSE '06. 4小时+'
        END AS duration_tier
    FROM CombinedDuration
)

SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    duration_tier AS "在线时长区间",
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "用户数",
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_name), 2) AS "占比(%)"
FROM DurationBuckets
GROUP BY cohort_name, duration_tier
ORDER BY "对比组", "在线时长区间"
